IMPORTANT: Save it under spec/debug/{feature_name/issue_name}. Do not create or modify any files other than Markdown files.
If the document is 600 lines or fewer, place everything in a single file:
spec/debug/{feature_name/issue_name}.md
If it exceeds 600 lines, split it into multiple files numbered sequentially within the folder:
spec/debug/{feature_name/issue_name}/01.md, 02.md, and so on.
